‘PEOPLE POWER VS. DUTERTE’S EJKS’

LOOK: Akbayan Partylist, along with Simbahan at Komunidad Laban sa Katiwalian (SIKLAB) and families of drug war victims, held a rally calling for the conviction of former president Rodrigo Duterte before the International Criminal Court (ICC) at Scout Circle on Monday, Feb 23, also the start of his confirmation of charges hearing.

Akbayan leaders Rafaela David and Rep. Perci Cendaña invoked the spirit of EDSA, saying the power of the people can claim accountability and justice as it brought back democracy.

“From EDSA to the ICC, the call is clear: an end to the culture of state-sponsored violence against the Filipino people. We have already won over the murderous Marcos regime four decades ago. Now, we will claim justice against Duterte and his bloody war on the poor,” David added. | 📸: Akbayan Partylist/Facebook via John Andrei Gutierrez, https://t.co/E0yNJSWpUY trainee

NCRPO spokesperson Maj. Hazel Asilo on Monday (Feb. 23, 2026) says the Quezon City government had granted a permit for the Trillion Peso March Movement along EDSA Whiteplains on Feb. 25, coinciding with the 40th anniversary of the EDSA People Power Revolution.

As for the White Plains rally, Asilo said the permit excluded the People Power Monument itself, limited the number of participants to only 20,000 and prohibited the groups from marching to another area to continue the rally beyond the set time and date. l Lloyd Caliwan

data.text:
Ininspeksyon ngayong araw ng Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) ang isinasagawang dry run ng bagong traffic management scheme sa kahabaan ng C3 Road bago ang Quezon Avenue sa Quezon City.

Bilang bahagi ng dry run, inilipat ang U-turn slot sa northbound lane na mas malapit sa Skyway off-ramp upang mas maayos na maipamahagi ang volume ng mga sasakyan. Mayroon ding inilagay na overhead signages upang gabayan ang mga motorista patungo sa kani-kanilang destinasyon.

Sa ilalim ng ipinatutupad na rerouting, ang mga sasakyang magmumula sa Skyway ay maaaring gumamit ng itinakdang U-turn slot, habang ang mga sasakyang magmumula sa Service Road ay pinapayuhang dumiretso sa susunod na U-turn slot sa Maria Clara. Samantala, ang mga sasakyang magmumula naman sa España Rotonda ay kinakailangang kumanan sa Araneta Avenue at mag-U-turn sa Kaliraya.

Layunin ng bagong traffic scheme na mabawasan ang matinding trapiko sa C3–Quezon Avenue intersection na matagal nang itinuturing na choke point. 

#mmda

LOOK: Members of various labor groups stage a protest outside the Department of Justice along Padre Faura Street in Ermita, Manila, on Monday, Feb. 23, calling for the release of detained unionists and political prisoners.

The groups highlight the case of Marklen Maojo “Maoj” Maga, who has been in jail since 2018 over what they describe as trumped-up charges, and report that at least 18 workers and unionists nationwide remain behind bars. 

📸: John Louie Abrina/MB

EDSA PEOPLE POWER AS REGULAR HOLIDAY

Isinusulong ng Akbayan Party-list sa Kamara na gawing regular holiday sa buong bansa ang paggunita sa 1986 EDSA People Power Revolution tuwing Feb. 25.

Inihain ni Akbayan Rep. Chel Diokno ang panukala kasama sina Rep. Perci Cendaña at Dadah Kiram Ismula, at Dinagat Islands Representative Kaka Bag-ao.

Layon nitong bigyang-pugay ang mapayapang rebolusyon sa EDSA na tumapos sa diktaduryang Marcos at nagbalik ng demokrasya sa bansa.

“Democracy survives not by accident, but because the people choose to defend it,” pahayag ni Diokno.
